{{DL|Nimbasa City|Rondez-View Ferris Wheel}} }} '''Special Delivery''' (Japanese: '''VS エモンガ''' ''VS Emolga''), titled '''VS Emolga''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 483rd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 23rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Emolga''' (Japanese: '''開演''' ''Opening Curtain'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Special Delivery''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} The first performance of the [[Pokémon Musical]] begins, as a full audience watches. Afterward, [[Elesa]] steps onto the stage to explain the concept of the Musical, emphasizing the use of [[Prop]]s and their impact. When she is finished, she meets {{adv|White}} backstage, who praises her for her work. The next step in White's plan is to give each audience member a [[Prop Case]] to encourage their further participation in the Musical, but she soon discovers that the shipment has been delayed due to the lifting of the [[Driftveil Drawbridge]]. The Mayor of [[Nimbasa City]] suggests to forgo giving out the Prop Cases, but White refuses, determined to keep the Musical a success. She decides that their next course of action is to schedule an urgent delivery by airplane, offering to pay the cost of transportation herself. The performances come to an end, and White arrives onstage to promise each audience member that they will receive Props and a Prop Case. She has the audience line up for them, but after some time waiting, they begin to grow impatient. Soon enough, an airplane drops down the shipment in front of the building, then leaves a message in the sky to promote the Musical. Later, the audience members leave happily with their Prop Cases, excited to return the next day. Proud of herself and the efforts of her crew, White tears up. She suggests getting everything prepared for the next performance, but the crew advises her to get some sleep, pointing out she has been working without rest for days. Suddenly feeling her exhaustion, White staggers toward her hotel. On her way, she accidentally walks into someone, who then leads her into a seat as she begins to fall asleep. When White awakens, she finds herself in a Ferris wheel car, cornered there by {{adv|N}}. ==Major events== * The [[Pokémon Musical]] begins. * Because of the [[Driftveil Drawbridge]] not lowering, supplies for the Pokémon Musical are unable to be sent in time. * {{adv|White}} manages to get the supplies on time with the help of the Mistralton Cargo Service. * {{adv|Black}} goes to start his Gym battle with [[Elesa]]. * {{adv|N}}'s {{adv|Amanda|Snivy}} is revealed to have evolved into a {{p|Servine}}. * N traps White in one of the Ferris Wheel cars. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Skyla]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Servine}} * {{p|Gothita}} * {{p|Accelgor}} * {{p|Stunfisk}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * {{adv|White}} * {{adv|N}} * [[Elesa]] * [[Skyla]] * Mayor of Nimbasa City * [[Chairtarō]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munna}} ([[Musha]]; {{adv|Black}}'s) * {{p|Tepig}} ([[Gigi]]; {{adv|White}}'s) * {{p|Servine}} ({{adv|Amanda|N's}}) * {{p|Emolga}} ([[Elesa]]'s) * {{p|Swoobat}} ([[Skyla]]'s) * {{p|Elgyem}} ({{tc|Preschooler}}'s) * {{p|Tranquill}} ({{tc|Socialite}}'s) * {{p|Deerling}} ({{tc|Pokémon Ranger}}'s; Spring Form) * {{p|Maractus}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Throh}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Petilil}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Minccino}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Gothita}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Panpour}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Pidove}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Patrat}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Pansage}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Scraggy}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Herdier}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Accelgor}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Stunfisk}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Mienfoo}} (Trainer's) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|BW}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|BW}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 導電飛鼠 - 開演|VS Emolga - Begin a Play}} |fr_eu={{tt|Tous en scène !
